cli.intro: OpenEDA — create, inspect, edit and export schematic design documents on one native model.

cmd.capabilities: Print what this build supports, honestly
cmd.create: Create a native design document and save it to a project file
cmd.open: Open a design document and print its committed revision and sheets
cmd.diff: Compare two design documents and report added, removed and modified sheets, components, nets and buses
cmd.annotate: Renumber every component reference designator by sheet and placement order
cmd.list: List components, nets and wires of a design document
cmd.symbols: List the symbol library a design document uses, with pin counts and missing footprints
cmd.library: Read a KiCad .kicad_sym symbol library and report its symbols, units and pins
cmd.connectivity: Report what each net connects, the pins no net reaches and the per-sheet wire totals
cmd.inspect: Run electrical rule checks on a design document
cmd.export: Project a design document to a supported exchange format
cmd.import: Import a KiCad schematic into a native design document
cmd.undo: Undo the newest edit of a design document and save it in place
cmd.redo: Redo the newest undone edit of a design document and save it in place
cmd.design-set: Set title, drawing revision, company and date in place
cmd.component-add: Add a component to a design document in place
cmd.component-move: Move a placed component in place
cmd.component-update: Replace the value text of a placed component in place
cmd.component-footprint: Assign or clear the footprint of a placed component in place
cmd.component-pin-type: Assign or clear the electrical role of one component pin in place
cmd.component-delete: Delete a placed component and its net nodes in place
cmd.net-connect: Connect REF.PIN nodes to a named net in place
cmd.net-rename: Rename a net and update the wires that referenced it
cmd.net-derive: Name every connected wire group of a sheet in place
cmd.net-disconnect: Remove REF.PIN nodes from a net while keeping the net and its wires
cmd.net-delete: Delete a net and detach the wires that named it
cmd.bus-add: Declare a bus the netlist expands into member nets
cmd.bus-list: List the buses a design document declares
cmd.bus-remove: Remove a declared bus by id or name
cmd.variant: Manage BOM variants and their do-not-populate lists
cmd.variant-add: Declare or replace a BOM variant with DNP designators and value overrides
cmd.variant-list: List the BOM variants a design document declares
cmd.variant-remove: Remove a BOM variant by name
cmd.wire-delete: Delete a wire segment in place
cmd.junction-add: Add a junction (connection dot) to a design document in place
cmd.junction-delete: Delete the junction at a 0-based index in place
cmd.junction-move: Move the junction at a 0-based index in place
cmd.no-connect-add: Add a no-connect flag, optionally marking one component pin as deliberately open
cmd.no-connect-delete: Delete the no-connect flag at a 0-based index in place
cmd.text-add: Add a free text annotation to a design document in place
cmd.text-delete: Delete the text annotation at a 0-based index in place
cmd.text-move: Move the text annotation at a 0-based index in place
cmd.sheet-add: Add an empty sheet to a design document in place
cmd.sheet-delete: Delete an empty sheet in place
cmd.gui: Open the OpenEDA Studio window on the native design

opt.title: Design title
opt.rev: Drawing revision label from the title block, for example A
opt.company: Company or organisation in the title block
opt.template: Template the design starts from (only blank is implemented)
opt.overwrite: Replace the output file when it already exists
opt.checks: Comma-separated checks: erc, electrical, nets, connectivity, footprints, power (drc and clearance are unsupported)
opt.severity: Comma-separated finding overrides in code=level form, level error, warning, info or off
opt.waive: Comma-separated accepted findings: code, code@objectId or code@sheetId/objectId
opt.format: Export target: net, net_csv, net_hier, spice, spice_subckt, svg, pdf, bom, bom_json, bom_html, report, json or kicad_sch (kicad_pcb and gbr are unsupported)
opt.footprint: Footprint text, for example Resistor_SMD:R_0805_2012Metric (empty clears it)
opt.clear: Clear the current value instead of setting one
opt.pin: Pin name for a no-connect mark, for example 4
opt.sheet: Sheet id or name (defaults to the first sheet)
opt.name: New name
opt.net: Net name or id, for example VCC
opt.nodes: Comma-separated REF.PIN nodes, for example R1.1,C1.1
opt.bus: Bus id or name, for example DATA
opt.dnp: Comma-separated reference designators that are not populated, for example R2,R5
opt.variant: BOM variant to apply; only bom, bom_json and bom_html accept one
opt.variant-values: Comma-separated value overrides in ref=value form, for example R1=22k
opt.width: Number of member nets the bus expands to
opt.index: 0-based position inside the sheet's junction or text list
